text:
anya: Heads-up: noticed the inspect dashboard reporting 0 samples for /v2/generate for a small slice of traffic, but edge logs show sample=1 tags for those requests.

raj: That sounds like the inspect quota short-circuit. Router returns 204/ACK and drops the body, right?

tom: Yep. Edge makes the sampling decision and sets X-RDW-SAMPLED, but the downstream path that enqueues the payload to the collector bails when tenant inspect_quota is hit. Console only increments when collector receives payload.

anya: From an audit perspective this is bad - decision!=visible. We should surface that mismatch.

raj: Agreed. Proposal A: emit an opaque audit token at the decision point and always forward that token even if we drop the body. Token is HMAC(route+sample_id+tenant) so itis verifiable but contains no raw PII.

emily: That lets legal verify a decision happened without exposing content. But legal/legal-compliance might still request scrubbed payloads for escalations. I'll loop them in.

anya: Nice. Also add a Prom metric sample_forward_discarded with labels {route, tenant_id, discard_reason} so we can alert on unexpected drops.

ops-bot: referenced playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/sample-visibility - suggestion: add missing metric(sample_forward_discarded).

raj: Console UX: show three numbers next to route: decisions / tokens_forwarded / payloads_collected. Use a small amber indicator if tokens_forwarded > payloads_collected.

tom: Implementation detail: we keep redaction at collector. Token doesn't require KMS at edge. If legal requires scrubbed payloads, consider a secure-forward path where edge can redact using a limited-scoped KMS key and forward the scrubbed sample. That would be a heavier change.

emily: For short-term debugging we should add an admin-only toggle "expedite_sample_forward" for a tenant so SRE can temporarily force forward sampled payloads for a short TTL. RBAC+audit required.

anya: config example for toggle: 
```json
{"tenant": "acme", "route": "/v2/generate", "expedite_sample_forward": true, "expires_at": 1690000000}
```

raj: Telemetry note: label metrics with redaction_state values: none | token_only | redacted | full_collected. That makes downstream dashboards easier to query.

ops-bot: created task T-9901: add_metric:sample_forward_discarded, admin_toggle:expedite_sample_forward, console_panel:sample_audit_breakdown -> assignees [raj,tom,anya]

emily: Filing RFC (draft): https://redwood.internal/rfcs/5790-sample-audit-token. Will assign eng-privacy, eng-sre, console-ux.

tom: For rollout plan: 1) ship token + metric + console panel in canary region 2) enable admin toggle for verification 3) ask privacy/legal about secure-forward path requirements 4) if legal insists, propose edge-redact with restricted KMS key and extra audit.

anya: I'll run a short canary to validate token integrity (HMAC check) and dashboard plumbing once T-9901 lands. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:
